title: John Lennon attends Mick Jagger’s Christmas Day party | 1976
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a Christmas Day party thrown by Mick and Bianca Jagger on 25 December 1976.

The party was held at the Jaggers’ home at 132 East 71st Street on the Upper East Side of Manhattan. Known as the Bakwin Townhouse, the five-story residence was originally a Queen Anne-style twin built in 1884 but was reclad in its current neo-Federal brick style in 1928.

Mick sat down next to Bob Colacello and put his arm around him and offered him a pick-me-up, and Bob said, ‘Why yes, I am rather tired,’ and just as he was about to get it, Yoko and John Lennon walked in and Mick was so excited to see them that he ran over with the spoon that he was about to put under Bob’s nose and put it under John Lennon’s.
Andy Warhol
The Andy Warhol Diaries
